name: Maren

essence.purpose: We make everyday stoneware that slows the table down.

personality.line: Nothing shouts. Space does the work.
Every surface should make you want to touch it.

essence.write: Thrown by hand in small batches, glazed in the colours of the harbour.
essence.avoid: Discover our amazing handcrafted collection, made with passion!
essence.letter: Thank you for your order. Each piece was thrown, trimmed and glazed in our studio, so no two are quite the same. Please allow the glaze a week before the first wash.

logo.unitLabel: half the height of the logo
logo.smallUse: Below that, use the ring symbol on its own.

colors.name: Clay
colors.use: One call to action per page

samples.Headline: Made by hand on the coast
samples.Title: Calm, tactile, precise
samples.Body: Each bowl is thrown, trimmed and glazed in our studio, in batches of twelve.
samples.Caption: Harbour bowl, sea glaze, 14 cm

rules: Headlines in Newsreader, sentence case, never in capitals
Body in Hanken Grotesk, 16 px minimum on screen
No italics: emphasis comes from weight or colour
One idea per page. White space is part of the product.
Images bleed off the edge or sit on the grid, they never float.

imagery.direction: Natural daylight, close enough to see the glaze. Objects in use, on real tables, never on seamless white.
do: Hands, food and table in the frame
dont: Filters, grain or heavy colour grading

pairings.why: Editorial and calm: a book serif over a quiet grotesque.
Softer and warmer, closer to the hand.
All sans, sharper and more modern.

never: Use the accent for more than one call to action per page
Put the logo on a photograph without a calm, solid area
Use more than two weights on one page
Add gradients or shadows to anything
Write more than three words in capitals
